problems.title: Heron’s formula
problems.question: Find the area of a triangle with sides 5,6,7.
problems.idea: Use its semiperimeter.

problems.title: Positive factor times an absolute value
problems.question: Find the sum of integer solutions of x|x²-4x+3|>0 on [-2,7].
problems.idea: The absolute value is positive except at its two zeros.
steps: The product requires x>0 and x≠1,3.
problems.note: None of the printed numerical choices equals 24.

problems.title: A median identifies the input
problems.question: The nonnegative numbers x,x²,1 have median 1/4. Find their mean.
problems.idea: Determine which number can be in the middle.
steps: A median below 1 forces 0≤x<1 and makes the median x. Thus x=1/4.

problems.title: Maximize area with two fixed sides
problems.question: Triangle sides are 3,5,a. For which a is its area greatest?
problems.idea: The included angle gives the area directly.
steps: The maximum occurs at θ=90° between the fixed sides.

problems.title: Cancel a factor but retain its missing point
problems.question: Solve (3x²+5x-8)/(x²-3x+2)<0.
problems.idea: Factor numerator and denominator first.
steps: A sign chart gives negativity between -8/3 and 2.
Remove the original forbidden point x=1.

problems.title: Integer values of the same rational function
problems.question: For how many integer x is (3x²+5x-8)/(x²-3x+2) an integer?
problems.idea: After cancellation the nonconstant part is 14/(x-2).
steps: x-2 must be one of ±1,±2,±7,±14, giving eight candidate integers.
The candidate x=1 is forbidden by the original denominator.

problems.title: Circumradius from an obtuse included angle
problems.question: AB=6,AC=9,A=120°. Find the circumradius.
problems.idea: Find BC by the cosine rule, then use the sine rule.

problems.title: Recover a function from its shifted input
problems.question: For every real x, f(2x+1)=8x²+12x+3. Solve f(x)=x.
problems.idea: Let t=2x+1.

problems.title: Area from three parabola features
problems.question: For y=x²-6x+8, A is the vertex, B the y-intercept and C the rightmost x-intercept. Find area ABC.
problems.idea: Read the three coordinates algebraically.

problems.title: Right-triangle area using its inradius
problems.question: A right triangle has hypotenuse c and inradius r. Find its area.
problems.idea: Area equals inradius times semiperimeter.

problems.title: Rhombus inscribed at the 60-degree vertex
problems.question: A right triangle has shorter leg 3√3 and an acute angle 60°. An inscribed rhombus shares that angle. Find its area.
problems.idea: Use similarity to find the common rhombus side.
formulas: For adjacent triangle sides b,c, inscribed rhombus side s=bc/(b+c); rhombus area=s²sinθ.
steps: At the 60° vertex the adjacent sides are 3√3 and 6√3.

problems.title: An acute condition selects the cosine sign
problems.question: An acute triangle has two sides 2√2,3 and area 3. Find the third side.
problems.idea: Use the area to determine the included angle.
steps: sinθ=6/(6√2)=1/√2. Since the triangle is acute, θ=45°.
The third side is √5; its three sides also satisfy all acute-angle square inequalities.

problems.title: Four rectangle areas form a proportion
problems.question: A rectangle is split by one vertical and one horizontal line. The top areas are 4,5 and bottom-right area 3. Find bottom-left area.
problems.idea: The row-height ratio is the same in each column.

problems.title: Parallelogram area from two altitudes
problems.question: A parallelogram has altitudes 1.2,2.5 and perimeter 22.2. Find its area.
problems.idea: Each side is area divided by its corresponding height.

problems.title: Shift the minimum to zero
problems.question: Find a if f(x)=2x²-10x+a has minimum 0.
problems.idea: Complete the square.
steps: Set it to zero to get a=25/2.

problems.title: Equal squared linear expressions
problems.question: Solve (2x+7)²=(2x-2)².
problems.idea: Use both signs.
steps: The same-sign case gives 7=-2 and is impossible.

problems.title: A quadratic with opposite-sign roots
problems.question: f(x)=ax²+bx-a is quadratic. How many roots has |f(|x|)|=0?
problems.idea: Only the positive root of f can be reached by |x|.
steps: The two roots of f are real, nonzero and opposite in sign.
Only its one positive root r gives |x|=r.
That produces exactly x=r and x=-r.

problems.title: Area of the special rectangle
problems.question: The perpendicular bisector of diagonal KM of rectangle KLMN meets KL,MN at A,B. AB=BM=6. Find its area.
problems.idea: Use the same diagonal symmetry relations for the side lengths.
formulas: If BM=t, rectangle sides are 3t/2 and √3t/2.
steps: To derive them, put A=(t,0),B=(w-t,h). Perpendicularity gives w(w-2t)+h²=0 and AB=t gives (w-2t)²+h²=t².
For t=6 the sides are 9 and 3√3, so area is 27√3.

problems.title: Altitude from the two split areas
problems.question: In right ABC with altitude CD to the hypotenuse, areas ACD,BCD are 18,2. Find CD.
problems.idea: Use the altitude theorem after expressing both hypotenuse parts.
steps: Put h=CD. Then AD=36/h and BD=4/h.
The altitude theorem gives h²=144/h², so h⁴=144.

problems.title: A downward quadratic is positive between its roots
problems.question: Solve -4x²+x+3>0.
problems.idea: Factor and test the sign between the roots.
steps: Because the leading coefficient is negative, the expression is positive strictly between them.

problems.title: Translate the parabola vertex
problems.question: y=(x+a)²+b is obtained from y=x²-4x+1 by moving right 6 and up 5. Find a-b.
problems.idea: Translate the vertex.
formulas: Original y=(x-2)²-3; right shift adds to the vertex x-coordinate.
steps: The new vertex is (8,2), so the new equation is (x-8)²+2.

problems.title: Reduce using a root equation
problems.question: If m²+3m+a=0, simplify (2-m)(m+5).
problems.idea: Expand and replace the quadratic combination.

problems.title: A quadratic strictly positive everywhere
problems.question: Find a so ax²+x+a>0 for every real x.
problems.idea: The leading coefficient must be positive and the discriminant negative.
steps: If a≤0, a nonpositive leading coefficient or the linear case fails somewhere.
For a>0, strict positivity requires a²>1/4.
Thus a>1/2. Equality would give a zero, violating strictness.

problems.title: Inverse of a restricted square-root function
problems.question: Find the inverse of y=√(x-5)+5 for x≥5.
problems.idea: Isolate the square root and remember its range.
steps: After exchanging variable names, the inverse is y=(x-5)²+5, with x≥5.

problems.title: Root distance equals the discriminant square root
problems.question: Find the distance between the roots of x²-ax+0.5a-0.25=0 for a=1.99.
problems.idea: Use the difference of the quadratic-formula roots.
